newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil coffee region weather forecast stable - Somar.
newsitem.headline: Brazil coffee region weather forecast stable - Somar.

text.p: The weather is set to remain stable in Brazil's key coffee growing regions this week, with minimum temperatures rising in the next few days, independent meteorologist Somar said.
"The tendency is for the gradual rise in temperatures to continue," said Somar forecaster Marcos Massari.
A mass of subtropical air was forecast to keep conditions stable and dry in the coffee regions at the start of the week.
"Tomorrow the minimum temperature should be seven degrees Celsius in Pocos de Caldas and it should start to warm up from Wednesday onward," Massari said.

By next weekend, a new cold front will move eastwards from the country's south-east, increasing cloud cover in coffee producing areas. But the cold air front linked to this system will be weak and will only affect the south, Somar said.
